title: Mark ls-and-rg Check lines as runnable by read-only roles, or have ork run them itself, instead of leaving them to the orchestrator

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261122-031627-c98e, project ork, item S400:

Mark ls-and-rg Check lines as runnable by read-only roles, or have ork run them itself, instead of leaving them to the orchestrator

Evidence: `ls testdata/golden | rg 'runtree-fix-round-real'` came through as "not run by ork: orchestrator", though one plain ls of the four paths answers it
